title: Specified tower transpose source and finite evaluation words
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, normalized tower data and the full constructible finite-Tor compact-support adjunction, together with an open/proper factorization f=j followed by p. Define originalSource as the inverse realization of the tensor source with its membership proof. Define originalComposite as the fully faithful preimage of the realized projection/counit composite. At a positive coefficient level define dualizingWord using the coefficient-unit isomorphism and counit-preserving right-adjoint comparison. Define tensorWord by the specified pullback and tensor comparisons, finiteTheta as finite gamma at identity orientation followed by the unique comparison, and intrinsicTheta by transporting this map through the inverse tensorWord comparison and fixed level comparisons. These are precisely the existing constructions of the tower tensor transpose, separated into a shared definitions module. Use the coefficient, tower adjunction, smooth purity, tensor and level-word notions in the listed statement dependencies.
